description: Public media proxy settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.PublicMediaConfig.

signing_key.description: Signing key for public media URLs. Set to 'generate' for auto-generation.

expiry.description: Expiry time for public media URLs in seconds. 0 means no expiry.

hash_length.description: Length of the hash in public media URLs.

path_prefix.description: URL path prefix for the public media endpoint.

use_database.description: Store public media URL mappings in the database.
